artworks.title: Mlle. Etienne-Goconde-Cunégonde-Bécassine
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on chine collé
artworks.description: The image depicts a person from the waist up, seated and turned slightly to the right. They hold a fan in their right hand near their shoulder. The person has exaggerated facial features, closed eyes, and a stern expression. Their hair is styled in an elaborate updo with a floral wreath or decorative elements. They wear ornate clothing with lace, ruffles, and a brooch at the neckline. The person accessorizes with earrings and gloves. In the background, there is a shaded area contrasting with a lighter section resembling drapery or a curtain to the right. The image is detailed with fine lines for texture and shading.

artworks.title: Emotions Parisiennes: Une Victime des Factions
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man walking in the rain. He is wearing a hat resembling a military helmet and a heavy coat, and carrying a rifle. The man appears determined, with a long, curved nose and a hunched posture. The background features Parisian-style buildings and heavy rain.

artworks.title: Sesta Scena di Tutto Cielo
artworks.artist: Stefano Della Bella after Alfonso Parigi II
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 20.5 x 28.5 cm (8 1/16 x 11 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a theatrical stage with a curtain and multiple figures depicted in the clouds. The image shows a fantastical scene set in an ethereal environment, with many small figures engaged in various activities within a layered landscape. The curtain frames the top of the drawing, suggesting a theatrical performance, while the clouds serve as platforms for groups of figures. Some figures appear to be engaged in dance or poses. The higher layers are populated by crowds, adding to the sense of scale and depth. The title at the bottom reads "Sesta Scena di Tutto Cielo."

artworks.title: Head of a Woman Looking Up
artworks.artist: Gilles Demarteau, the Elder after François Boucher
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in black and orange-red
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (3rd framing line): 20.9 x 16 cm (8 1/4 x 6 5/16 in.)
image: 19.5 x 14.9 cm (7 11/16 x 5 7/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Philip and Judith Benedict
artworks.description: The image shows the upper part of a person's body with the focus on the head and shoulder. The individual's head is tilted upwards, looking towards the upper right corner of the frame. The facial features include a prominent nose and slightly parted lips. The person's hair is wavy, cascading around the head and down the neck. They are wearing draped fabric over their shoulder. The drawing style emphasizes contours and shadows, creating depth and texture. The background is a plain, textured surface.

artworks.title: Head of a Young Woman
artworks.artist: Gilles Demarteau, the Elder after Antoine Watteau
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in red and black
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (4th framing line): 24.1 x 16.5 cm (9 1/2 x 6 1/2 in.)
image: 21.7 x 14.9 cm (8 9/16 x 5 7/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Philip and Judith Benedict
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a woman's body, focusing on her head and shoulders. She is turned slightly downward and to the left. The woman has soft facial features and a calm expression. Her hair is styled in a bun with a ribbon and partially covered by a wide-brimmed hat. She wears layered fabric with textured folds. The background is a simple, lightly textured surface.

artworks.title: Battling Tritons
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 8.9 x 14.6 cm (3 1/2 x 5 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows mythological creatures in a struggle. A figure with a mermaid-like tail is in conflict with another figure. The tailed figure holds a large bone, preparing to strike the other being. Three other creatures are partially submerged in turbulent waters, observing or involved in the struggle. The background features dramatic waves and detailed reeds, adding to the chaotic scene. The drawing conveys movement, capturing a moment of tension and energy.

artworks.title: Elegant Young Woman with a Pearl Necklace
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on light brown laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a head-and-shoulders portrait of a person with a slightly turned body. The person is looking towards the viewer with a subtle head tilt. They have delicate facial features, including arched eyebrows, wide eyes, and a soft smile. Their curly hair frames their face. The person is wearing a garment with folds and a visible ribbon at the shoulder. They have a bead necklace around their neck. The background has curved and straight hatching lines.

artworks.title: Three Figures in a Gallery
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural scene with classical columns and structures. The drawing depicts a detailed perspective with a prominent colonnade, ornately decorated columns with Corinthian capitals, a curving platform, layered structural forms, arched windows, and curved walls. Additionally, there are classical figures in the foreground.

artworks.title: "Les Maris me font toujours rire" (Husbands Always Make Me Laugh)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts two men standing side by side from the waist up in a frontal position. The man on the left has a wide nose, prominent cheeks, and slicked-back hair. He is dressed in a dark jacket, white shirt, and a bow tie, with a light-colored vest. The man on the right also has a broad nose, a pronounced grin, and wavy hair. He is wearing a dark jacket and white shirt without a tie or vest. Both men have slightly bent arms, with one holding an object. The background features a simple hatched pattern.

artworks.title: Estan Calientes (They Are Hot)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint with burnishing on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group of figures gathered around a table. The scene features several figures in robes, who are engrossed in a meal, as indicated by the plate and spoon in the foreground. The expressions on the figures' faces vary, with one appearing to speak or sing with a wide-open mouth, and another with a sly grin. The colors are muted, with a focus on the contrast between light and dark areas, highlighting the figures' faces and the folds of their robes.

artworks.title: Buen Viage (Bon Voyage)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, and engraving with burnishing on laid paper

artworks.title: The Conversation
artworks.medium: mezzotint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals standing and seated, both from the waist up. The man has long, curly hair and wears a coat with a lace cravat. The woman also has curly hair and wears a dress with puffed sleeves and lace detail, along with a lace headpiece. The woman's hand rests on the chair's arm, while the other hand holds a letter on the table to her left. The table has a patterned cloth with items such as a dish and a glass. The background is a plain, dark wall.

artworks.title: Marcelle la Brune
artworks.medium: lithograph in green on paper
artworks.description: This image shows a portrait of a person with their head and shoulders visible. The individual is facing forward with a slight turn of the head towards the side. The face has stylized features, including large eyes and defined lips. The short hair is depicted in a sleek manner. The person is wearing a simple collar. Below the image is the text "MARCELLE LA BRUNE." The background consists of abstract, angular shapes, suggesting a cubist influence.

artworks.title: Intérieur d'un Port
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on chine collé
artworks.description: The image shows a bustling port scene with boats docked alongside a stone embankment. Figures are busy on the dock, possibly unloading goods. A half-timbered building with a gabled roof stands out in the center. The background features masts of ships reaching towards the sky. The sky is textured, contrasting with the detailed architecture and human figures below. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of black and gray.

artworks.title: Château de Pesteil à Polminhac
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on chine collé
artworks.description: This image shows a view from an elevated perspective down a dirt path curving towards a castle in a dense landscape. The horizon is formed by the castle's roofline and surrounding trees. A fence and cart are near the path, leading towards the castle. The stone structures are detailed with precise lines while the trees are portrayed with more fluid strokes. The color scheme is monochromatic with shades of gray and black. The sky has swirling clouds framing the scene.

artworks.title: River Landscape
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Philip and Judith Benedict
artworks.description: The image is a drawing of a natural landscape. The scene includes trees and a gently sloping hill. A path curves into the image surrounded by trees. The trees are detailed with light brushwork. In the background, distant trees are visible at the horizon. The drawing is monochromatic in sepia tones, using varied line thickness and cross-hatching for texture.

artworks.title: Sir Edward John Poynter
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Philip and Judith Benedict
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a person depicted from the shoulders up in a three-quarter view. The subject is turned slightly to their left, looking at the viewer. They have a beard and mustache, with a calm expression, and detailed skin textures. The hair is neatly combed back. The clothing consists of a suit and collared shirt, indicated by etched lines. There are no visible accessories or objects. The background has a simple lined texture, providing contrast to the figure.

artworks.title: Alfred, Lord Tennyson
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on chine collé
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed pencil drawing of a man's head and shoulders. The man is turned slightly to his left, with deeply-set eyes, a prominent nose, and a full, bushy beard. He wears a wide-brimmed hat and has unkempt, curly hair that merges with his beard. There are minimal details on his clothing. The background is plain, and the drawing is signed in the bottom right corner by A. Legros.

artworks.title: Diana and Endymion
artworks.artist: Nicolas Le Sueur after Sebastiano Conca
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed from three blocks: black line block and gray-blue and light blue tone blocks on heavy laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two main figures with additional smaller figures above them. The central figure on the left is reclining with their eyes closed, resting their head on their right hand, and their left hand across the body. This person has long, wavy hair and a bare chest. The figure next to them is seated, facing the reclining person, while holding a long staff or spear. This person has hair styled neatly back and wears a draped garment. Above these two figures, there are two cherubic figures with wings, one holding a curved horn-like object. At the base, two dogs are present, one with its head up looking towards the viewer. The background features shaded illustrations of foliage and a circular design framing the seated figure's head.

artworks.title: A Heath
artworks.medium: mezzotint in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon line is in the distance where the land meets the sky. Along the horizon, there are a few trees and a small cluster of buildings. The artistic technique employed consists of fine, detailed brushstrokes, characteristic of etching. The color palette is a monochrome range of blacks, whites, and grays. Closest to us, there is a horse-drawn cart with a person steering it, and a dog nearby, on a winding path leading into rolling hills. The path meanders towards the distance where clusters of trees and cultivated land can be seen. Above, the sky is vast and filled with billowing clouds, through which a few birds are soaring.

artworks.title: Pride
artworks.medium: engraving in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body view of a woman standing in a graceful pose. She is holding a hand-held fan with feathers. Her head is slightly tilted to the right, looking down at the fan. She has a calm expression, finely drawn eyes, and elaborate wavy hair piled up on top of her head. She is wearing classical robes with intricate folds and an ornate collar, along with a string of pearls around her neck and a bracelet on her wrist. Two small crests with different motifs are in the corners. The background has a textured pattern, possibly representing a wall or drapery.

artworks.title: Three Hobos on the Artist's Signature
artworks.medium: graphite on light brown wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three sketched figures and bold calligraphy. The figures are roughly sketched in a loose style that suggests movement. They appear to be wearing old-fashioned clothing. The drawing uses light pencil strokes for details and darker strokes for outlines and shadows. Below the figures are large signatures. The figures are depicted with dynamic poses, each facing different directions.

artworks.title: Bacchus
artworks.medium: black chalk with gray wash on blue paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person with only the upper portion of their body visible. The person is depicted in a dynamic, turned position, with one arm raised. Their face is partially obscured but has a strong profile with a prominent nose and closed eyes. The hair appears styled or adorned with what looks like foliage or leaves. The person's clothing is a draped garment, possibly a tunic, highlighted with sketch-like lines suggesting fabric folds and motion. There is no visible jewelry or held objects due to the sketch's simplicity and style. The background is minimally detailed, with coarse shading.

artworks.title: Ehrenbreitstein
artworks.artist: John Pye after Joseph Mallord William Turner
artworks.medium: engraving on chine collé
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a view leading from a group of people beside a fountain to a distant fortress on a hill. Trees are on the right, and there is a built-up area with structures and a bridge over water. The sky above has soft brushstrokes and clouds, reflecting light. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of gray and black creating a serene atmosphere.
